netlist:
C Cin VIN1 n1
L Lg n1 n2
NMOS M1 n4 n2 n3 VSS
L Ls n3 VSS
L Ld VDD n4
C Ct1 n4 n5
C Ct2 n5 VSS
C Cout n5 VOUT1
PMOS M2 n6 VDD n5 VDD
R Rbias VDD n6
rationale: The proposed topology improves the power efficiency by replacing the resistive biasing (Rbias) with a current mirror-based biasing using a PMOS transistor, which reduces static current draw while maintaining proper gate voltage for M1. This directly addresses the binding constraint of excessive IDD (11.46 mA vs 10 mA max) without degrading noise figure, S11, or gain, as the current mirror ensures stable bias with minimal quiescent current. The addition of a single PMOS in a current mirror configuration is compliant with the device budget and process constraints.
